HEAD_SHA_PIN.algorithm: sort entries by repo; canonical JSON {entries:[{head,repo}]} with sorted keys; SHA-256 UTF-8; head must be 40-char hex or INVALID

MEMBERSHIP_IDENTITY_PIN.algorithm: sort entries by family then id; canonical JSON {entries,unknownFamilies}; SHA-256 UTF-8
MEMBERSHIP_IDENTITY_PIN.unknown_families: omitted from entries and listed separately; never stored as zero

honesty: A pin is a snapshot of fact, not a claim of health.
kernels ≠ models even when Hub IDs overlap
membership ≠ tree hash ≠ content review ≠ qualification
file_audit_complete cannot be true at source_content_files_read=0
forbidden: treat a membership pin as a file audit
